metadata.title: CPCB Harmonized Classification of Industrial Sectors (Red, Orange, Green, White)
metadata.issuing_authority: Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB), Ministry of Environment, Forest & Climate Change
metadata.disclaimer: Curated statutory reference table for compliance planning. Final categorization for novel processes is subject to SPCB verification.

sectors.description: High-precision computer numerical control (CNC) metal turning, cutting, component washing with alkaline detergents, and cooling fluids.
sectors.effluent_characteristic: Spent cutting oils and industrial wash-water requiring specialized oil-water separation.
sectors.source: CPCB Harmonized Classification - Orange Category (Serial No. 28)

sectors.description: Chemical and electrochemical deposition of metallic coatings (nickel, chrome, zinc, copper) involving toxic heavy metal baths and acidic pickling rinse.
sectors.effluent_characteristic: Toxic heavy metal discharge (Hexavalent Chromium, Cyanide, Nickel, Zinc) requiring dedicated chemical treatment plant (ETP).
sectors.source: CPCB Harmonized Classification - Red Category (Serial No. 12)

sectors.description: Cleaning, sorting, de-husking, milling of wheat, rice, pulses, and grain dehydration without chemically intensive processing.
sectors.effluent_characteristic: Organic suspended solids and biodegradable washing residues.
sectors.source: CPCB Harmonized Classification - Green Category (Serial No. 19)

sectors.description: Cleanroom surface-mount assembly of populated printed circuit boards (SMT), dry testing, robotic placement, and electronic enclosure packaging.
sectors.effluent_characteristic: Zero industrial process effluent discharge. Practically non-polluting.
sectors.source: CPCB Harmonized Classification - White Category (Serial No. 04)

sectors.sector_name: Specialty Chemicals & Synthetic Organic Chemical Formulation
sectors.description: Synthesis, polymerization, and formulation of industrial organic chemicals, bulk drugs, dyestuffs, and synthetic resins.
sectors.effluent_characteristic: High COD/BOD chemical discharge and volatile organic compounds (VOCs) requiring multi-stage effluent treatment with ZLD.
sectors.source: CPCB Harmonized Classification - Red Category (Serial No. 03)

sectors.sector_name: Textile Weaving, Knitting & Fabric Manufacturing (Without Dyeing)
sectors.description: Mechanical spinning, weaving, warp sizing with natural starch, and fabric knitting without chemical dyeing or bleaching.
sectors.effluent_characteristic: Minimal effluent from sizing wash; particulate cotton dust managed via suction bag filters.
sectors.source: CPCB Harmonized Classification - Green Category (Serial No. 34)

sectors.sector_name: Automobile Servicing, Mechanical Overhaul & Body Building
sectors.description: Automotive assembly workshops, mechanical component repair, chassis fabrication, spray painting booths, and fleet maintenance.
sectors.effluent_characteristic: Oily sludge, solvent residues, and spent hydraulic fluid.
sectors.source: CPCB Harmonized Classification - Orange Category (Serial No. 07)

sectors.sector_name: Dry Packaging, Corrugated Box & Paper Carton Assembly
sectors.description: Corrugated board slitting, folding, paper carton die-cutting, stitching, and warehouse dry box packaging using water-based non-toxic adhesives.
sectors.effluent_characteristic: Zero hazardous effluent; dry paper scrap recycling loop.
sectors.source: CPCB Harmonized Classification - White Category (Serial No. 11)

sectors.sector_name: Dairy Processing, Milk Chilling & Butter/Ghee Manufacturing
sectors.description: Receiving raw milk, pasteurization, homogenization, cheese/butter production, and cold chain distribution.
sectors.effluent_characteristic: High organic biological oxygen demand (BOD) wash-water from dairy equipment clean-in-place (CIP) systems.
sectors.source: CPCB Harmonized Classification - Orange Category (Serial No. 18)

sectors.sector_name: Solar Photovoltaic Cell Panel Assembly & Solar Inverters
sectors.description: Assembly of imported solar crystalline PV cells, lamination onto glass backing, aluminum frame mounting, and junction box soldering.
sectors.effluent_characteristic: Zero chemical processing; purely dry electrical panel assembly.
sectors.source: CPCB Harmonized Classification - White Category (Serial No. 22)

sectors.description: Blending active pharmaceutical ingredients (API) with excipients, granulation, tablet compression, syrup formulation, and blister packaging.
sectors.effluent_characteristic: Equipment washings containing pharmaceutical residues requiring dedicated effluent containment and neutralisation.
sectors.source: CPCB Harmonized Classification - Orange Category (Serial No. 44)

sectors.sector_name: Foundry, Metal Smelting & Induction Furnace Casting
sectors.description: Melting ferrous and non-ferrous scrap in electric induction furnaces, cupola furnaces, and pouring molten metal into sand molds.
sectors.effluent_characteristic: Heavy particulate emissions, sulfur dioxide, slag waste, and sand reclamation residues.
sectors.source: CPCB Harmonized Classification - Red Category (Serial No. 20)
